_comment: Per-(exercise-type x locale) deck-description floor skill sentences (Commission 16b; tiered in C19). Each type has {full, short} complete-sentence tiers. buildSeoHead inserts the FULL sentence when core+full <= 170, else the SHORT sentence if it fits, else drops to core — NEVER truncating mid-sentence. Reader-perspective, ground-truth (distilled from the 3-agent-verified C1-C13 topicMeta exercise-type entries; re-authored for best SEO by native SEO+K-3 expert agents in C19). Only en/es/pt carry published decks.
